name: How it works, with booking card
description: Three icon steps followed by a highlighted card with a booking button.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Three steps to a training plan that fits your week

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: No gym contract and no app to learn. Just a coach who plans around your job, your kids and your knees.

default.title: Book a call
default.text: Pick a 20-minute slot. We ask about your goals, old injuries and how much time you really have.

default.title: Get your plan
default.text: Within two days you get a 12-week plan with every session, from warm-up to stretch.

default.title: Start training
default.text: Log each session in your shared sheet. Your coach adjusts the plan every Sunday.

fields.name: cardText
fields.label: Card text
fields.default: Twenty minutes with a certified coach. No card needed and no obligation to sign up.
